
The Woodland Chronicle
======================

Project Documentation
---------------------

The Woodland Chronicle is a Django-based news application that allows
readers to follow publishers and independent journalists, journalists
to create articles and newsletters, and editors to review and approve
articles before publication.

This documentation describes the application's models, views, and
main Python modules.
